name: Store League & Rank Bump Chart
note: A store league whose rows are subgrid items, so re-ranking on a period change is a FLIP of whole rows with the Web Animations API, beside a bump chart whose lines morph by transitioning the CSS d property and dim each other through :has(); a regional manager view rolls the same weekly ledger up into conic-gradient rings driven by a registered @property angle. Height is --drt-league-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Rota vs Footfall · Coverage Planner

Height is --drt-staffing-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Floor Heat · Store Map
note: A store floor plan whose heat is summed from Gaussian kernels into a low-resolution intensity field, colourised through a 256-step lookup table built from four CSS custom properties, and upscaled onto a DPR-aware canvas under an SVG plan; a scrubber and play loop interpolate the field between hours, pause off screen and in hidden tabs, and FLIP the zone ranking on each hour change. Height is --drt-floor-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Shrink Ledger · Stock Reconciliation
note: A stock reconciliation set like a ledger: a zero-free waterfall (with a drawn axis break) walks expected stock through each loss type to the counted figure, every loss built up from individual incident records so the bars, the store lollipops, the category benchmarks and the incident log always reconcile; clicking a loss bar opens the log pre-filtered, and incidents open in an in-component drawer with Escape and focus return. Height is --drt-shrink-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Shelf Gaps · Planogram Scan
note: An aisle drawn as a planogram on one CSS grid (bays, uprights and shelf lips are grid items; display:contents rows keep the ARIA grid intact), with packs shaped per product type by clip-path and gaps hatched, so every number in the KPIs, the aisle list and the pick list is counted from the same simulated shelf scans. Arrow keys move through the shelf like a spreadsheet; filling a gap re-stocks it with a spring and flows through every total. Height is --drt-gaps-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Basket Mix · Transaction Scatter
note: Every till transaction is a dot on a DPR-aware canvas (items across, basket value on a log scale), with marginal histograms in SVG sharing its scales; drag to brush a region, or click a histogram bar, and the selection panel recounts baskets, sales share, basket size and category mix from the same records. A second view breaks sales into transactions × items per basket × price per item as synced small multiples with a log-share bridge whose parts add up exactly. Height is --drt-basket-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Front End Live · Checkout Queues
note: A live front-end board driven by a small discrete-event simulation (seeded arrivals, scan rates, self-checkout help calls) stepped from one requestAnimationFrame loop that pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; customers are keyed DOM dots that slide forward with transitions, the serving ring is an @property number eased between ticks, and opening or closing a till changes the queues, the one-in-front rate, the live chart and the day totals together. A lane expands in place with FLIP. Height is --drt-queue-h (680px), which can be set to 100dvh in an app.
